question: Which deities are traditionally identified as the lords of the three twilights?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are named together.
The three twilights are specified as a domain.
These deities are remembered as lords of that domain.
inference: Therefore Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are remembered as the lords of the three twilights.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are remembered as the lords of the three twilights.
